app_store_info.title: CricOS — Cricket Operating Sys
app_store_info.subtitle: Scoring, Turfs & Tournaments
app_store_info.promotional_text: The all-in-one cricket operating system. Live scoring, instant turf booking, tournament scheduling, and official ICC Net Run Rate standings.
app_store_info.description:
CricOS is the comprehensive Cricket Operating System and Marketplace designed for players, captains, umpires, scorers, and tournament organisers.

KEY CAPABILITIES:

• TACTICAL LIVE MATCH SCORING:
- Fast, intuitive numeric pad with one-tap scoring for dots, singles, boundaries, and sixes.
- 8-Zone Wagon Wheel shot direction tracking and partnership milestones.
- Real-time Fall of Wickets (FoW) chronology and strike rotation.
- Offline-first outbox queue ensures you never lose a ball during network disconnects.

• TURF & GROUND BOOKINGS:
- Real-time availability for natural turf, astro-turf, and floodlit grounds.
- 15-minute authoritative holds prevent double-booking collisions.
- Transparent commercial fee breakdown with double-entry escrow security.

• TOURNAMENT OPERATING SYSTEM:
- Polygon round-robin automated schedule generation.
- Official ICC Net Run Rate (NRR) calculations with 3-decimal precision.
- Group stages, Super 4s, playoffs, and tournament leaderboards.

• UMPIRE & OFFICIAL NETWORK:
- Certified umpire and scorer marketplace with Bayesian reputation scores.
- Digital toss management, playing XI confirmation, and official sign-off.

• STORE & PRIVACY COMPLIANCE:
- In-app irreversible account deletion compliant with Apple Guideline 5.1.1(v).
- Zero third-party data tracking. Your sporting privacy is guaranteed.
